description: Ground-truth manifest of planted synthetic scenarios for Mission 72 verification.
notice: This manifest is strictly for automated test validation and verification reporting. Detection engine code must NEVER import or consult this manifest.

scenarios.name: Repeated Authentication Failures (Brute Force)
scenarios.description: 6 consecutive failed logins within 60 seconds from external IP 203.0.113.45 targeting user victor.

scenarios.name: Failure Burst Followed by Successful Login
scenarios.description: 4 consecutive failures followed immediately by a successful authentication within 90 seconds for charlie.

scenarios.name: Password Spraying Across Multiple Accounts
scenarios.description: Single source IP 198.51.100.99 attempts authentication across 5 distinct user accounts within 120s, all failing.

scenarios.name: Unusual Nighttime Login
scenarios.description: Successful login at 03:15 UTC for diana, who exclusively authenticated during 08:00–16:00 UTC in training.

scenarios.name: Successful Login from New IP and Location
scenarios.description: Successful login from external IP 203.0.113.190 (External / Remote Access) not seen during training for edward.

scenarios.name: Sudden Access to Many Unfamiliar Hosts
scenarios.description: User frank accesses 5 previously-unseen servers (DCs, databases, LDAP) within 90 minutes.

scenarios.name: Benign Maintenance-Window Activity
scenarios.description: Off-hours backup job on Sunday at 02:30 UTC for svc_backup is suppressed by maintenance window policy.

scenarios.name: Approved VPN Activity
scenarios.description: Login from 192.0.2.88 inside approved corporate VPN CIDR 192.0.2.0/24 is suppressed by VPN policy.

scenarios.name: Duplicate Records
scenarios.description: Identical rows are detected by stable content hash; duplicate count is tracked in IngestionReport.

scenarios.name: Malformed Rows and Invalid Timestamps
scenarios.description: Malformed rows with missing fields, invalid dates, or illegal IPs are safely rejected into invalidRows.

scenarios.name: Authorized Helpdesk Maintenance Activity (Scenario A)
scenarios.description: Authorized helpdesk account accesses 5 permitted hosts during declared Sunday maintenance window. Alert is suppressed with recorded contextual exception reason.

scenarios.name: Out-of-Scope Helpdesk Access (Scenario B)
scenarios.description: Authorized helpdesk account accesses 5 new hosts outside the declared maintenance window (Tuesday 10:00 UTC). Normal new_hosts rule fires.

scenarios.name: Suspicious Authentication During Maintenance (Scenario E)
scenarios.description: Failure burst followed by successful authentication during maintenance window. Authentication attack detection is not suppressed.

scenarios.name: Maintenance Window Boundary Cases (Scenario F)
scenarios.description: Boundary events tested immediately inside and outside window boundaries (01:58 outside, 02:02 inside, 03:58 inside, 04:02 outside).
